India news: Modi proposes e-visas for ASEAN tourists
Published November 17, 2026last updated November 17, 2026
Speaking at the ASEAN summit in Manila, Modi said that India's development and ASEAN's prosperity are "deeply interconnected."
What you need to know
- Modi is meeting the Quad leaders on the margins of the ASEAN summit in Manila
- The prime minister proposed free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries
- Cyclone Akvan is expected to cross Andhra Pradesh coast on November 20 as a 'very severe cyclonic storm'
Here is a roundup of headlines from India on Tuesday, November 17:
Dhoni retires from IPL, becomes CSK mentor
Former Chennai Super Kings (CSK) captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni retired from the Indian Premier League (IPL) — a professional Twenty20 (T20) cricket league in India — ahead of the 2027 season.
He will take up the role of mentor at CSK, the franchise announced on Tuesday.
CSK said that Dhoni would continue to be part of the Super Kings' journey in a "new capacity" after years of leading them to success.
Since its formation, Dhoni has been an integral part of CSK and has led it to multiple IPL titles.
"There is no CSK without MS Dhoni. For nearly two decades, we have walked and grown alongside each other, through triumphs, setbacks and everything in between," N Srinivasan, owner of Chennai Super Kings, said in an official statement.
"Our relationship is as strong as it is because of one reason: we don’t question intentions. That trust is what made this journey possible," he added.
Modi proposes measures to deepen ASEAN-India ties
Indian PM Narendra Modi has promised a series of initiatives to bolster India-ASEAN ties, including free e-visas for tourists from ASEAN countries, a long-term maritime cooperation plan, nuclear energy technical exchanges and collaboration in critical minerals.
At the summit, Modi underscored that India's development and ASEAN's prosperity are "deeply interconnected."
"Our partnership has now moved beyond shared culture and heritage, reaching new dimensions in sectors such as digital, defence, and space," ANI cited the prime minister as saying.
"Since 2014, we have undertaken over 100 initiatives to strengthen people-to-people ties, launched nearly 250 Quick Impact Projects, and provided more than 10,000 scholarships for skill development. Today, the direct flights and growing tourism between India and the nine ASEAN nations are further evidence of our close ties."
Andhra Pradesh to be hit by third cyclone 'Akvan'
The southern state of Andhra Pradesh is bracing itself for the cyclone Akvan — the third to hit the state within three weeks.
The system is moving north-northwestwards over the central parts of the south and adjoining west-central Bay of Bengal. It is expected to get stronger over the next two days as it moves towards the Andhra Pradesh coast.
Akvan is expected to make landfall on November 20 as a "very severe cyclonic storm," according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD).
The IMD has issued a red alert for several districts, warning of extremely heavy rainfall on November 20.
As a precautionary measure, the IMD has suggested a total suspension of fishing operations near the Bay of Bengal until November 20.
The cyclone will bring heavy rainfall to parts of the adjoining states of Odisha and Tamil Nadu.
PM Modi to meet Quad leaders in Manila
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to join the leaders of Australia, Japan and the US for a Quad Leaders' Summit and hold several bilateral meetings in the Philippine capital, Manila.
This is the first meeting between Modi and US President Donald Trump since the US midterm elections took place.
Modi and Trump are not expected to hold any bilateral talks on the sidelines of the summit, instead Indian news outlet The Print reported that a bilateral meeting is planned for next month in Florida, on the margins of the G20 leaders' summit.
Modi is also attending the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)-India summit and the 21st East Asia Summit today.
At the ASEAN meet, maritime security, economic cooperation and development partnership are expected to dominate the agenda.
In his departure statement, Modi said India's relationship with ASEAN was "at the heart of India’s Act East Policy" and central to its MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) vision.
"Our ties, rooted in centuries of civilisational exchanges, have grown into a dynamic partnership spanning trade, connectivity, maritime security, technology and people-to-people relations," he said.
Welcome to our coverage
Hello! This is Midhat from DW's New Delhi bureau, bringing you the latest news from across India.
Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is in the Philippines to attend the ASEAN summit on the sidelines of which he will also attend a Quad leaders' summit.
Meanwhile, the state of Andhra Pradesh is bracing for a third cyclone after cyclones Arnab and Murasu wreaked havoc in the state. The state is facing a third cyclone within the span of three weeks.
Stay tuned as we bring you more news from India.
digest_he:
במהלך השתתפותו בוועידת ASEAN במנילה, ראש ממשלת הודו נרנדרה מודי הציע שורה של צעדים לחיזוק הקשרים עם מדינות הארגון, ובהם מתן אשרות אלקטרוניות חינם לתיירים ממדינות ASEAN והידוק שיתופי הפעולה בתחומי הכלכלה, האנרגיה הגרעינית והביטחון הימי. מודי הדגיש כי פיתוחה של הודו ושגשוגן של מדינות ASEAN קשורים זה בזה באופן עמוק.

בזירה המקומית, מדינת אנדרה פרדש שבהודו נערכת לקראת הגעתו הצפויה של ציקלון אקוואן, הסופה השלישית הפוקדת את האזור בתוך שלושה שבועות. המטאורולוגיה ההודית פרסמה התראות אדומות לקראת פגיעת הסופה החזקה הצפויה בימים הקרובים. בנוסף, בעולם הספורט, מאנדרה סינג דוהוני הודיע על פרישתו מליגת ה-IPL ועל מעברו לתפקיד מנטור בקבוצת צ'נאי סופר קינגס.
